findings.rule: Exact [lua( guard; regex \[lua\((?!lua).*\)\], default Regex options (dot does not cross LF). Starts with last ordinal [lua( and processes a suffix, then moves left; maximum100 scans. Evaluator extracts substring(5,length-7), Trim(), prefixes return-space unless StartsWith("return "), calls Lua.Run(logInfo). Result.asString replaces the match; caught failure returns empty with conditional warning. Runtime Lua result, side effects and successful execution unaccepted.

Exact [var=? guard; regex \[var=\?.*\] is greedy within a line. Same reverse suffix scan/max100. Evaluator extracts substring(6,length-7).Trim(), stores varName and returns empty. Final varName is returned, remaining text is not trimmed. For separate normal tags, leftmost is processed last; a later bracket can be absorbed into a key. Empty extracted key makes hasVariableInputPrompt false. Runs after Lua and before ReplaceVarTags.

Exact [var= guard; regex \[var=[^\]]*\]. Reverse suffix/max100. Evaluator substring(5,length-6).Trim() -> DialogueLua.GetVariable -> Result.asString; caught failure returns empty. Does not rerun earlier prompt/Lua stages on injected content; downstream stages can consume it.

Exact [autocase= guard; regex \[autocase=[^\]]*\]. Reverse suffix/max100; capitalization computed from prefix before that tag. Skip only ASCII space and LF walking backwards; start or .!? capitalizes, other characters lower-case. Evaluator substring(10,length-11).Trim() -> GetVariable.asString; empty stays empty; caught failure returns empty. Original uses current-culture .NET Char/string case functions, not a locale-neutral mapping. Original FirstLetterToLower incorrectly calls ToUpper for a one-character value; record, never repair original.

Every literal pipe becomes LF. Each exact flag is detected by Contains and removed everywhere by String.Replace; case and spacing matter, no trimming. noSubtitle is independent of whether text is empty. Dynamic output from earlier stages can introduce flags/pipes.

findings.rule: If exact [pic is present, run pic,pica,picc regexes in that order: \[pic=[0-9a-zA-z_]+\] and corresponding prefixes. Preserve original A-z range typo. Each match extracts after first equals to final bracket; Int32.TryParse else DialogueLua.GetVariable(...).asInt without evaluator catch. Last match writes final index, every match removed; defaults0. All actual scoped matches are positive numeric Int32 values; no Lua fallback needed on these unchanged inputs.

Position starts-1, guarded space form [position plus space with regex \[position\s+[0-9]+\], then equals form \[position=[0-9]+\]; panel starts-1 and uses \[panel=[0-9]+\]. TryParse writes out field (failed conversion gives0), matches removed; last match in each pass wins, equals pass after space pass. Absent in all scoped raw inputs.
